services.name: Deep Sea Fishing
services.desc: No experience required for you to join us on this fun, Deep Sea Fishing tour in Halifax; a desire for a truly authentic East Coast experience is all you’ll need to get hooked! With all gear onboard including bait, rods and lures, you and your experienced Captain and crew will set off in search of mackerel, cod, pollock, and other sea fish. You’ll begin this 2-hour adventure by cruising along the Halifax Waterfront, past Georges Island National Historic Site and McNabs Island, all in search of best fishing spots.
